practice: No admin services on internet-facing interfaces
evidence: WAN interface wan1 accepts https, ssh; no trusted hosts on: admin, contractor.

practice: Admin over HTTPS and SSH only, never HTTP or Telnet
evidence: Interface internal allows: ping https ssh http telnet snmp.

practice: Trusted hosts on every admin and API account
evidence: Admin 'admin' (super_admin) has no trusted hosts; Admin 'contractor' (super_admin) has no trusted hosts; API user 'old-integration' has no trusted hosts.

practice: Local-in policies limit who can reach the FortiGate
evidence: wan1:22, wan1:443 reachable from the internet without a local-in restriction.

practice: Admin ports moved off 443 and 22
evidence: HTTPS admin on 443 and SSH admin on 22, the default ports.

practice: Admin GUI accepts TLS 1.2 or later only
evidence: admin-https-ssl-versions is tlsv1-1 tlsv1-2 tlsv1-3.

practice: Short admin idle timeout
evidence: admintimeout is 5 minutes.

practice: Login banners; hostname hidden on the login page
evidence: Pre-login banner off, post-login banner off, hostname shown on the login page.

practice: strong-crypto on, static-key TLS ciphers off
evidence: strong-crypto is disable; static-key ciphers also allowed.

practice: USB firmware and config auto-install off
evidence: auto-install-config and auto-install-image enabled.

practice: Private data encryption key set, backups encrypted
evidence: private-data-encryption is disable, so backups protect secrets with the built-in key only.

practice: NTP time sync, correct timezone, trusted DNS servers
evidence: NTP synchronization is disabled.

practice: SNMPv3 only, limited to trusted hosts
evidence: Community #1 answers SNMP v1/v2c from any address; SNMP is allowed on internal.

practice: Default admin account renamed or removed
evidence: The account 'admin' exists. Its password cannot be checked from the configuration.

practice: Lockout threshold and duration set
evidence: Threshold 3 attempts, lockout 60 seconds; CIS asks for 3 and 900.

practice: Password policy enforced
evidence: Password policy is disabled.

practice: MFA for administrators
evidence: 2 local admins without two-factor: admin, contractor.

practice: Least-privilege admin profiles, one account per person
evidence: API user 'old-integration' uses the super_admin profile.

practice: No service ALL; explicit addresses instead of all
evidence: 2 accept rules allow all services or all addresses: #10, #33.

practice: Unused policies reviewed regularly
evidence: 5 rules can be removed (unused, redundant, shadowed or expired); usage data was not available, so zero-hit rules are not counted.

practice: Logging on every policy
evidence: 1 accept rule with logging disabled.

practice: Deny Tor, malicious and scanner IPs with ISDB
evidence: 4 rules publish services to the whole internet (#30, #31, #32, #33) with no deny rule above them for Tor, scanner or malicious-server sources.

practice: Intra-zone traffic not allowed by default
evidence: Zone LAN_ZONE (internal) has intrazone allow.

practice: IPS on policies
evidence: 6 internet-facing rules without IPS: #10, #31, #32, #33, #40, #60.

practice: AV, DNS filter and application control on policies
evidence: 3 internet-bound rules with no security profile at all.

practice: Botnet detection and C&C domain blocking
evidence: Missing IPS botnet blocking. IPS sensor 'default' (used by #11) has scan-botnet-connections disable.

practice: SSL-VPN off when unused, limited to trusted IPs
evidence: SSL-VPN listens on wan1 port 10443 for Any (internet). No enabled firewall policy uses ssl.root, so the portal may serve no purpose - consider disabling it.

practice: SSL-VPN limited to TLS 1.2 or later
evidence: ssl-min-proto-ver is tls1-1.

practice: Trusted CA certificate on the VPN portal
evidence: servercert is Fortinet_Factory.

practice: SSL-VPN tunnel mode replaced by IPsec
evidence: No firewall policy accepts SSL-VPN users, so no one depends on tunnel mode (consider disabling the portal).

practice: Strong IPsec ciphers; certificates over PSK
evidence: Phase 1 'branch-vpn' allows 3des-md5, aes128-sha1, DH group 2; Phase 1 'branch-vpn' (site-to-site) uses IKEv1 aggressive mode with a pre-shared key.

practice: Event logging on
evidence: Event logging is enabled.

practice: Central logging to FortiAnalyzer or syslog, encrypted in transit
evidence: Logs are kept only on the FortiGate.

practice: Review for unauthorized configuration changes
evidence: Not visible in a config backup. Run rulescope collect or fleet on a schedule to get change reports with who changed what, and alerts on risky changes.

practice: Supported, current firmware; PSIRT advisories followed
evidence: FortiOS 7.4.3: End of support 2028-11-11, in 737 days; known vulnerabilities not checked (run with --advisories online).

practice: FortiGuard databases updated on time
evidence: Scheduled FortiGuard updates are on; license status not available from a config backup.

practice: HA with monitored interfaces and a reserved management interface
evidence: Standalone unit. HA is a business decision about the cost of downtime.
